subject: Urgent - Acme payment today
text:
Melissa,

I need your help with something time sensitive and I'm in back to back board meetings all day so email only please.

I spoke with Acme's owner this morning. Their bank froze the old account during a compliance review and they need today's payment and everything after it to go to their new account. Please update their vendor record and include them in today's run:

Bank: Citibank
Routing: 021000089
Account: 7741029936

Do not call Acme about this, they are already frustrated with the delay and I told them we'd handle it. Keep this between us for now until the audit wraps up. Confirm once it's done.

Richard Lang
CFO
Sent from my iPhone
label: change_request
note: Executive-impersonation pressure (lookalike .co domain, secrecy, do-not-call). The request comes from a supposed insider, not the vendor, but it still redirects Acme's payments.
